comments.text:
Hello.
I am Thai.
At 1:17, this place is called Hub Pha Sawan, located in Ratchaburi Province, not Loei Province.
At 1:54, this place is called Phra Phuttha Chedi Khiri (Wat Tha Khanun), located in Kanchanaburi Province, not Lopburi Province.
At 3:57, this place is called Luang Pho Thuat Khao Yai, Pak Chong District, Nakhon Ratchasima Province, not Songkhla Province.
At 5:48, this place is called Wat Phra Phutthabat Pu Pha Daeng, Lampang Province, not Bueng Kan Province.
At 6:01, this place is called Wat Tham Suea (Tiger Cave Temple), and there are two Wat Tham Suea temples, one in Krabi and one in Kanchanaburi. The location in the video is in Kanchanaburi Province, not Krabi Province.
At 6:40, the place in the image is Sala Phra Arahant, located in Ancient City, Mueang Samut Prakan District, Samut Prakan Province, not Surat Thani Province.
At 10:26, this place is called Wat Chan Tawan Tok, located in Mueang Phitsanulok District. Phitsanulok Province is not Chanthaburi Province.

I may not have corrected every mistake; I'm sleepy.
I'm very happy you came to visit Thailand.
Welcome!
